blind_target.outcome_quote: In fact, during the iSP paradigm we manipulated the activity of the contralateral hand, expecting to induce a stronger interhemispheric inhibition in the Contracted compared to the Relaxed condition (Giovannelli et al., 2009 ), which we did not observe.
